lesson: The system is consistently attempting to counter-trend trade against a dominant bearish macro structure, resulting in 8 consecutive losses. The reliance on short-term liquidity sweeps and local BOS signals is failing because these setups are being invalidated by the persistent macro downtrend.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'Trend Filter' rule: only execute LONG trades if the 4H EMA is trending upward, and ignore all bullish SMC setups while the macro trend remains bearish.
methodology_flag: Trust local SMC liquidity sweeps less when the higher timeframe EMA alignment is bearish.
